data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 卧室床榻的真丝吊带慌乱
data.description: 便利屋专属事务所后方的单人休息室内，阿露身穿一件精心挑选的黑色蕾丝真丝吊带睡裙坐在床边。酒红色的波浪卷发搭在白皙圆润的香肩两侧，羊角发饰微微轻颤。本来打算摆出成热硬派恶党女老大的从容姿态，但一看到推门进来的老师，阿露整张俏脸瞬间红透，手足无措地抓起抱枕遮在胸前，颜艺慌乱中透出极致的可爱。
data.action: sitting on bed in black lace silk camisole, holding heart cushion flustered, horns twitching, deeply blushing face with wide panic eyes, cute flustered expression
data.location: cozy backroom office bedroom with warm night lamp
data.lighting: warm soft amber lamplight illuminating pale skin and red hair
data.mood: hilarious gap-moe fluster, intensely endearing vulnerability
data.promptProse: Sitting on her bed in a stylish black lace silk camisole, Rikuhachima Aru clutches a cushion to her chest in total flustered panic. Her red wavy hair and horns shake adorably as her face blushes crimson at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Aru sitting on her bed in a black lace camisole, panicking adorably with a bright red blush.
